description: Defines the ReportingCacheImpl class implementing the ReportingCache interface for managing reporting reports, endpoints, clients, and related data structures in the Chromium project. Contains class declarations, data members, and method signatures for report and endpoint management.

classes.name: ReportingCacheImpl
classes.description: Implements the ReportingCache interface, managing reports, endpoints, clients, and related data structures for reporting in Chromium.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Represents a (NIK, origin) pair with associated endpoint groups and metadata.

methods.name: AddReport
methods.description: Adds a new report to the cache with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetReports
methods.description: Retrieves all reports currently stored.

methods.name: GetReportsAsValue
methods.description: Returns all reports as a base::Value for serialization.

methods.name: GetReportsToDeliver
methods.description: Returns reports ready for delivery.

methods.name: GetReportsToDeliverForSource
methods.description: Returns reports for a specific reporting source.

methods.name: ClearReportsPending
methods.description: Clears specified reports from pending status.

methods.name: IncrementReportsAttempts
methods.description: Increments the attempt count for specified reports.

methods.name: GetV1ReportingEndpointsByOrigin
methods.description: Returns V1 reporting endpoints grouped by origin.

methods.name: IncrementEndpointDeliveries
methods.description: Updates delivery stats for an endpoint.

methods.name: SetExpiredSource
methods.description: Marks a reporting source as expired.

methods.name: GetExpiredSources
methods.description: Returns set of expired reporting sources.

methods.name: RemoveReports
methods.description: Removes specified reports from cache.

methods.name: RemoveAllReports
methods.description: Clears all reports from cache.

methods.name: GetFullReportCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns total report count for testing.

methods.name: GetReportCountWithStatusForTesting
methods.description: Returns report count filtered by status for testing.

methods.name: IsReportPendingForTesting
methods.description: Checks if a report is pending, for testing.

methods.name: IsReportDoomedForTesting
methods.description: Checks if a report is doomed, for testing.

methods.name: OnParsedHeader
methods.description: Handles parsing of a header for a (NIK, origin) pair.

methods.name: OnParsedReportingEndpointsHeader
methods.description: Handles parsing of reporting endpoints header for a source.

methods.name: GetAllOrigins
methods.description: Returns all origins with clients.

methods.name: RemoveClient
methods.description: Removes a client for a given (NIK, origin).

methods.name: RemoveClientsForOrigin
methods.description: Removes all clients for a specific origin.

methods.name: RemoveAllClients
methods.description: Removes all clients.

methods.name: RemoveEndpointGroup
methods.description: Removes an endpoint group.

methods.name: RemoveEndpointsForUrl
methods.description: Removes endpoints matching a URL.

methods.name: RemoveSourceAndEndpoints
methods.description: Removes a reporting source and its endpoints.

methods.name: AddClientsLoadedFromStore
methods.description: Loads clients and endpoint groups from persistent storage.

methods.name: GetCandidateEndpointsForDelivery
methods.description: Retrieves candidate endpoints for report delivery.

methods.name: GetClientsAsValue
methods.description: Serializes clients to a base::Value.

methods.name: GetEndpointCount
methods.description: Returns total endpoint count.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes cache data.

methods.name: GetV1EndpointForTesting
methods.description: Retrieves a V1 endpoint for testing.

methods.name: GetEndpointForTesting
methods.description: Retrieves an endpoint for testing.

methods.name: EndpointGroupExistsForTesting
methods.description: Checks existence of an endpoint group for testing.

methods.name: ClientExistsForTesting
methods.description: Checks existence of a client for testing.

methods.name: GetEndpointGroupCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns count of endpoint groups for testing.

methods.name: GetClientCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns count of clients for testing.

methods.name: GetReportingSourceCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns count of reporting sources for testing.

methods.name: SetEndpointForTesting
methods.description: Sets an endpoint for testing.

methods.name: SetV1EndpointForTesting
methods.description: Sets a V1 endpoint for testing.

methods.name: GetIsolationInfoForEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves isolation info for an endpoint.
